name: Human Universal Load Carrier
maker: Ekso Bionics and Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory
def: Untethered hydraulic exoskeleton developed for soldiers by H. Kazerooni's team at Ekso Bionics, intended to help wearers carry loads of up to 200 pounds.
facts: Developed at the Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory from 2000
Unveiled on 26 February 2009 at the AUSA Winter Symposium, with Lockheed Martin taking an exclusive licence
Judged a failure because it hampered movement and increased muscle strain
